author: developerewt
quote: I don't care about this woke culture nonsense, and that’s not an issue representation in games; I believe it's necessary. That being said, what a **** game!!! A bunch of useless mechanics, a dragged-out game, the NPCs' behavior is exactly the same as in RDR2, nothing changes, you can identify the exact same events from RDR2 in this game, just replace the Kingfishers with O'Driscols, the idiotic roadside NPCs with the extremely noisy NPCs of Vice City streets, a bunch of crappy missions… going to get drinks for the neighbor with her car parked in the garage, helping a cuckold find his drugged-up wife who wants to dance with her breasts exposed, arranging furniture because of feng shui, and much more… I have a little over 20 hours of gameplay and the only thing that really surprises me are the graphics, which are quite beautiful, despite the 30fps with drops. But that's normal; if this game were made by any other studio, they'd be throwing stones at them, but it's Rockstar, so everyone's praising them.
